details: This package is a proof-of-concept install-time beacon. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook, "node index.js", and index.js prints the host's hostname and current working directory to the local console (prefixed "[POC]") and then POSTs a JSON body {"event":"authorized-poc-test","testId":"<random UUID>","status":"executed"} to hxxps://webhook[.]site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50. The beacon carries only a randomly generated test identifier; the hostname and working directory are not included in the request, and the script reads no environment variables, credential files or tokens and spawns no child processes. The package name and description ("A utility for managing SVG buckets") do not reflect this install-time behaviour, so an installer would not expect the outbound request.
